toolSpecs.title: Spin the wheel
toolSpecs.jtbd: Pasted or typed lines become wheel segments; one click, Enter, or Ctrl+Enter spins the wheel 2–5 seconds with a ticking sound and stops on a winner drawn by crypto.getRandomValues, shown as the largest element on screen.

typical.profile: 8–40 short lines: class names, menu options, prize labels

output.label: Winner
output.description: the winning entry rendered as the largest text on screen inside a winner overlay on the wheel, with Spin again / Remove winner / Count +1 keys and a results counter

toolSpecs.privacyNote: Entries and the draw never leave the visitor's device; crypto.getRandomValues does the picking, no network request is made.

toolSpecs.title: Load a preset wheel
toolSpecs.jtbd: One click loads a preset wheel — yes/no, numbers 1–10 or a custom range, dice 1–6, coin flip, letters, truth or dare, what to eat — with its entries filled in and spins it with the same engine.

output.label: A loaded wheel
output.description: the preset's entries fill the entries field and redraw the wheel with one segment per entry, ready to spin with the same engine

toolSpecs.privacyNote: Presets are static lists built into the page; loading one makes no network request.

toolSpecs.title: Random team generator
toolSpecs.jtbd: Split a pasted name list into N random teams drawn by crypto.getRandomValues and show each team's roster ready to copy.

typical.profile: a class roster of 10–40 names, one per line

output.label: Team rosters
output.description: Team 1…Team N, each headed 'Team k — m names' where m is the split's roster size (N names into T teams gives ⌈N/T⌉ per team at most, sizes differing by at most one), every name used exactly once, with

toolSpecs.title: Fairness audit
toolSpecs.jtbd: Run 10,000 spins of the current wheel at once and show each segment's observed frequency against the uniform expectation.

output.label: Frequency table
output.description: each entry's observed count and share of 10,000 spins beside its uniform expected share (10,000 ÷ number of entries, shown as a one-decimal percent, e.g. 16.7% for 6 entries)

toolSpecs.title: Send a message to the owner
toolSpecs.jtbd: Route a visitor's message — question, bug, business or billing — with their email to the site owner's monitored inbox and confirm the send on screen.

output.label: Confirmation
